newsitem.title: USA: Newmont, Santa Fe approve deal.
newsitem.headline: Newmont, Santa Fe approve deal.

text.p: Shareholders of Newmont Mining Corp and Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp at separate meetings on Monday approved Newmont's acquisition of Santa Fe, a Newmont spokesman said.
Under the previously announced agreement, Santa Fe Pacific holders received 0.43 of a Newmont share for each Santa Fe share.
Santa Fe Pacific holders approved the acquisition by 72.3 percent, with only 0.6 percent holders actually voting against it. Some people did not cast ballots.
Among Newmont holders, 74.8 percent approved the merger with 0.3 percent voting against.
A Newmont spokesman said the company will have a statement on the approved acquisition later on Monday.
